description: Read a received message's raw headers. Returns the SPF, DKIM and DMARC verdicts the receiver recorded, which domains authenticated and whether they align with the From domain (why DMARC failed on a message that "passed"), the relay hops and delays, the sending IP, plain-English issues, and whether the List-Unsubscribe headers satisfy one-click (RFC 8058). Text only: nothing is looked up or stored.

headers.description: The raw header block of a received message (Gmail: ⋮ → Show original).

title: Email header analysis
